variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: A political party has split in two in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: The colony has seen a party divide into two organisations. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: A split has divided a political party in the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
